Life is full of small surprises. Max's birthday is in September. Grace wrote about the day in the diary. What's more, under his chairmanship, the committee doubled its membership.
The bus stop is one of the best places in the city. Grace spent the weekend at the museum. Both of them like salad and milk. A no-show still pays the first night.
Grace hopes to visit Tokyo one day. Grace thinks math is interesting but a little difficult. It takes twenty minutes to get to the bus stop by bike. The minibar prices made her laugh.
Grace learned a lot about math. Grace bought a T-shirt at the shop yesterday. Max is interested in swimming.
